title: WalletAutoTopupDisabled
description: A wallet's automatic top-up switched itself off: the bank declined it too many times in a row, or its card was removed.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

org_id.description: The organization whose wallet it is.

user_id.description: The person who had set it up.

reason.title: AutoTopupOffReason
reason.description: `DECLINED`: the bank declined too many times in a row; `CARD_REMOVED`: the card it charged is gone; `AMOUNT`: its sum is outside what a top-up may carry now.
